title: Current through resistor R
description: Essential: Correctly calculates the current through the 5Ω resistor using Ohm's Law with the voltage drop across it.

title: Motor heating power
description: Essential: Correctly calculates the motor's Joule heating power using its coil resistance and the current through it.

title: Stalled motor current
description: Essential: Correctly calculates the current through the motor when its rotor is stuck, using the equivalent circuit resistance.

title: Bulb normal operation analysis
description: Important: Correctly determines the bulb's current and/or resistance from its rated voltage and power.

title: KCL at parallel junction
description: Important: Applies Kirchhoff's Current Law correctly to find the motor's operating current from the resistor and bulb currents.

title: KVL for voltage drops
description: Important: Applies Kirchhoff's Voltage Law correctly to find the voltage across the parallel branch (bulb and motor).

title: Equivalent resistance for stalled case
description: Important: Correctly calculates the equivalent resistance of the parallel bulb and motor coil when the motor is stalled.

title: Significant figures
description: Optional: Final answers are presented with two significant figures as requested.

title: Confusing motor operating parameters
description: Pitfall: Uses the motor's operating current (1A) to calculate the stalled current, ignoring the changed circuit conditions.

title: Incorrect power formula application
description: Pitfall: Attempts to calculate motor heating power using P=UI with the branch voltage, instead of P=I²r.
